reason: At app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss:522 the patch changes `.group-member-info .name` from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(... 50%, ... 50%)`, which matches the `.title` line at :527. The light-theme name therefore lightens from 30% to 50% (about #646464 to #909090 with the default #222 primary), the same shade as the title, while other converted 30% sites use (30%, 70%).
